evidence: The paper builds random forest models (splitrule=gini) but does not report variable importance from them: "We also assessed ROC-curves and the AUCs here." Feature rankings come instead from univariate ROC-AUC analysis ("The most discriminatory marker for hepatitis was CD4+ T cell frequency (AUC=0.630)") and FDR-corrected Wilcoxon tests, neither of which are impurity-based measures.
